'''Sassa district''' was a district on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], possibly of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Thousand Thousand]]. Its [[Sassa district's caliph|caliph's]] daughter was [[Woorta Woorta]].
